title: Core Rules
summary: The smallest playable resolution layer for Quadrath.

resolution.check: Roll 1d6 and add the relevant modifier. Meet or exceed the task difficulty to succeed.
resolution.contested: Each side rolls 1d6 plus the relevant modifier; the higher total wins. Reroll ties if the table needs a decisive result.

tiers.description: Skilled practitioners beginning to make a name for themselves.
Renowned heroes capable of remarkable feats.
Living legends whose deeds shape Quadrath.

combat.initiative: Each participant rolls 1d6 plus dexterity; highest acts first.
combat.attack: Roll 1d6 plus the modifier that best represents the attack. Meet or exceed the target's AC to hit.
combat.damage: The attack, weapon, spell, or effect defines its damage. The base package does not prescribe a universal damage table yet.
combat.hp: At 0 HP, a character is incapacitated until the table's recovery rules or an effect restores them. Detailed recovery is an extension point.
